ceremony.title: The wedding ceremony
body: A Bengali Hindu wedding is held under a mandap, a canopy on four pillars, before a sacred fire. It opens with the shubho drishti — the bride is carried in seated on a piri and circled seven times round the groom (the saat paak) before the two see each other, eyes meeting for the first time as the conch shells sound.

Then the mala badal, the exchange of garlands; the sampradan, the giving of the bride's hand; the saptapadi, seven steps round the fire, each a vow; and the sindoor daan, the vermilion in the parting of her hair that seals the marriage.
ceremony.dress: Traditional — saris, panjabis, lots of colour

story.heading: Our story
story.intro: A few of the moments that brought us here.

timeline.title: First date
timeline.text: Antara and Vivek bonded over their shared love for music, and shared pain in Computer Science. On their first date, Antara asked Vivek to teach her to play guitar... which was very short-lived unlike their relationship.

timeline.title: Failed foster parents
timeline.text: Antara and Vivek fostered their first cat. Poochie, at 23 days old, had every illness under the sun, but they managed to bring her back to health and ended up adopting her. She is now a sweet gremlin :)

timeline.title: Long-distance :(
timeline.text: After graduating from Carnegie Mellon University, Antara moved to Seattle to start her new job at Microsoft! Vivek stayed in Pittsburgh working at Carnegie Robotics. They frequently visited each other, and even adopted a second cat, Mochi (Mochachino Putupato)!

timeline.title: Grad school, new house, engagement!
timeline.text: Vivek got into the Master's program, and now a Ph.D student at Johns Hopkins University! Antara and Vivek moved into their first house together in Baltimore, and Vivek proposed to Antara on a beautiful summer day! They celebrated their engagment on August 2025 aboard the Catherine Marie in Annapolis, MD. The sunset drinks stole the evening!
